get.description:
Live Redis connectivity probe (set/get round-trip).

Use this to verify the VPC egress + REDIS_HOST wiring after a Cloud Run
deploy. ``{"status": "ok", "connected": true}`` means the service can reach
Memorystore on its private IP. Never 500s — a broken Redis reports
``connected: false`` with the reason so the check itself stays reachable.

Report the real-time fan-out mode.

Without Redis the WS gateway still works, but delivery is in-process only
and does NOT cross workers/instances — a failure that is invisible from the
UI (REST history stays correct while live events silently go missing). This
endpoint exists so a deploy can be *verified* rather than assumed.

``fanout: "redis"`` is the only correct state for multi-instance serving.

appointment_provider_source.description: Which tier fed #APPT_PRDR#: 'next', 'last', 'preferred' (the patient's preferred provider — no appointment on file), or null

fallback_tokens.title: Fallback Tokens
fallback_tokens.description: {token: tier} for tokens answered by a *degraded* tier. Empty when everything resolved from the upcoming appointment. A token the caller overrode is never listed.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The office clock #TODAY_DATE# was computed in (LTR-14)

MeFull.title: MeFull
MeFull.description: Composed identity context: the user + their tenant + assigned offices.

requires_balance.title: Requires Balance
requires_balance.description: Resolving this token runs the (slow) balance aggregate

requires_treatment_plan.title: Requires Treatment Plan
requires_treatment_plan.description: Only resolves when the letter is launched from a treatment plan

MergeFieldRead.title: MergeFieldRead
MergeFieldRead.description: One entry of the authoritative 56-token merge catalog (LTR-5).

MessagePage.title: MessagePage
MessagePage.description: Keyset page. `items` ascend (oldest first); `cursor` is the oldest id returned.

message.title: Message
examples: If the account exists, a reset link was sent.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: Effective date of the new version

name.title: Name

NewFeeScheduleVersionRequest.title: NewFeeScheduleVersionRequest
NewFeeScheduleVersionRequest.description: FEE-4: clone a schedule (and its entries) under a new effective date.

macro_count.title: Macro Count

outstanding_balance.title: Outstanding Balance
outstanding_balance.description: Total account balance across all patients

account_balance.description: Alias of balance for the FE

today_charges.title: Today Charges

opening_balance.title: Opening Balance
opening_balance.description: Seeded opening A/R (GAP-AP-12); already in balance/aging

total_refunded.title: Total Refunded
total_refunded.description: Sum of non-void refunds (REF-1); folded into balance

total_payment_debits.title: Total Payment Debits
total_payment_debits.description: AL-9: debit adjustments posted as payments; already inside total_charged

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: UTC timestamp the balance was computed

PatientBalance.title: PatientBalance
PatientBalance.description:
Computed account balance (charges − payments). Phase 3 cached aggregate.

The first three fields are the original contract; the rest are additive C-3
enrichments and are always present.

plan_name.title: Plan Name
plan_name.description: Carrier + group number — no plan-name column exists

PatientContextResponsibleParty.title: PatientContextResponsibleParty
PatientContextResponsibleParty.description: AL-12: "Responsible: <name>" in the ledger title row.

PatientFlagRules.title: PatientFlagRules
PatientFlagRules.description:
The Add/Edit Patient checkbox-integrity rules, served as data so the form
drives its own tick/untick behaviour from the same table the API enforces.

PatientImagingSummary.title: PatientImagingSummary
PatientImagingSummary.description: Lightweight counts for the imaging tab badge / patient overview.

sec_sub_rel_to_prim_sub.title: Sec Sub Rel To Prim Sub
Sec Sub Rel To Prim Sub
Sec Sub Rel To Prim Sub

PatientNoteDocumentRef.title: PatientNoteDocumentRef
PatientNoteDocumentRef.description:
The attached document, denormalised onto the note.

Deliberately a subset of ``PatientDocumentRead``: enough to render a link and
a file chip (name, type, size), never the internal ``file_path``.

PatientOverviewResponse.title: PatientOverviewResponse
PatientOverviewResponse.description:
Everything the legacy Patient Overview screen needs, in one call. The most
important blocks (patient, balance, account members) are fully typed; the
remaining resources are passed through as their existing row shapes.

PerioAutoAdvance.title: PerioAutoAdvance
PerioAutoAdvance.description:
Site-visiting order per arch/surface region. Each value is a direction
string over the tooth sequence, e.g. ``"01-08"`` (ascending) or ``"08-01"``
(descending). All eight regions are optional so partial templates are valid.

PerioChartSettingUpdateMe.title: PerioChartSettingUpdateMe
PerioChartSettingUpdateMe.description:
PERIO-BE-11: update the caller's own prefs (``user_id`` is taken from the
token, never the body).

PerioExamComparisonDelta.title: PerioExamComparisonDelta
PerioExamComparisonDelta.description: Change vs the chronologically previous exam in the comparison set.

PerioExamDetailsBulkUpsert.title: PerioExamDetailsBulkUpsert
PerioExamDetailsBulkUpsert.description:
One transactional write of (part of) a chart. Each item is insert-or-update
keyed by ``(exam_id, tooth_no)`` — naturally one row per tooth (PERIO-BE-1).

PerioExamRead.title: PerioExamRead
PerioExamRead.description: PERIO-BE-6: exam read with audit columns + resolved actor display names.

PerioExamSummary.title: PerioExamSummary
PerioExamSummary.description: Aggregate clinical metrics for a single exam (computed from its details).

PermissionRead.title: PermissionRead
PermissionRead.description: One assignable right in the global catalog (gap #1).

PickListItemWrite.title: PickListItemWrite
PickListItemWrite.description:
One item in an atomic replace. ``id`` present → update; absent → create.

``sort_order`` is advisory — the server normalises items to contiguous 1-based
order following the payload sequence (the list's display order).

patient_id.title: Patient Id
patient_id.description: Limit to one patient (omit = whole tenant)

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: Which instalment tables to sweep (default: all three)

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Report what would post without writing

PostDueRequest.title: PostDueRequest
PostDueRequest.description: PP-2 batch: post every instalment due on/before ``through_date``.

post_date.title: Post Date
post_date.description: Ledger date of service (defaults to the instalment's periodic_date)

procedure_code.title: Procedure Code
procedure_code.description: Billing code to charge (defaults to the instalment/contract code)

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: Defaults to the plan's pref_provider_id, then the patient's preferred provider

office_id.title: Office Id
office_id.description: Defaults to the plan's office, then the patient's home office

PostInstallmentRequest.title: PostInstallmentRequest
PostInstallmentRequest.description:
Overrides for a single posting. Everything is optional — the service
resolves each value from the contract, then the patient, before failing.

source.title: Source
source.description: ins | sec_ins | patient — which instalment table

paid_to_date.title: Paid To Date
paid_to_date.description: Patient payments allocated to the procedure

insurance_paid_to_date.title: Insurance Paid To Date
insurance_paid_to_date.description: Carrier money posted to the procedure

remaining_amount.title: Remaining Amount
remaining_amount.description: AL-15: the patient's share still owed — patient_estimate (or fee − insurance_estimate when none was recorded) − paid − adjusted

outstanding_amount.title: Outstanding Amount
outstanding_amount.description: AL-15: fee − paid − insurance_paid − adjusted (the legacy Outstanding line)

ProcedureAllocationsSummary.title: ProcedureAllocationsSummary
ProcedureAllocationsSummary.description: CHG-5: what has already been applied to one procedure, and by what.

ProcedureCodeCategory.title: ProcedureCodeCategory
ProcedureCodeCategory.description:
One row of the category taxonomy behind the Quick Add category buttons.

The picker used to derive its categories by paging the whole 1,100-code
catalog; this is the taxonomy on its own.

ProgressNoteSignRequest.title: ProgressNoteSignRequest
ProgressNoteSignRequest.description:
Empty/omitted → sign as the authenticated caller. Supplying valid
``username``+``password`` signs as that (verified) user instead.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Linked user account id; null to unlink

authorized_by.title: Authorized By
authorized_by.description: Overrides the token user as the authoriser

manager_approval_threshold.title: Manager Approval Threshold
manager_approval_threshold.description: Refunds strictly above this amount need manager approval

max_refund_without_source.title: Max Refund Without Source
max_refund_without_source.description: Cap for a refund not tied to a source payment

allow_over_credit.title: Allow Over Credit
allow_over_credit.description: Whether a refund may exceed the credit balance

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: Recomputed patient balance after the refund

unallocated_payments.title: Unallocated Payments
unallocated_payments.description: Payments not tied to an allocation

refundable_amount.title: Refundable Amount
refundable_amount.description: Max amount that may be refunded now

force_create.title: Force Create
force_create.description: Create even if a strong duplicate match exists (user confirmed).

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
One atomic registration: the patient plus any of the wizard's later steps.
Every sub-section is optional so the same endpoint serves Quick-Save and the
full wizard Finish.

production.title: Production
production.description: Σ procedure fees (non-void) in the window

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Σ patient payments (non-void) in the window

scheduled_appointments.title: Scheduled Appointments
scheduled_appointments.description: Non-cancelled, non-blocked appts in the window

insurance_receivables.title: Insurance Receivables
insurance_receivables.description: Σ (total_billed − total_paid) of outstanding active claims

outstanding_ar.title: Outstanding Ar
outstanding_ar.description: Practice-wide AR as of date_to (charges − payments − adjustments)

office_id.title: Office Id
office_id.description: Office scope, or null for all offices

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: UTC timestamp the summary was computed

ReportSummary.title: ReportSummary
ReportSummary.description:
Executive-dashboard KPIs for a tenant/office over [date_from, date_to].

``outstanding_ar`` is cumulative (all-time as of ``date_to``), not bounded by
``date_from`` — receivables are a running balance, not a windowed flow.

email.title: Email
email.description: Account email, for display when valid

ResponsiblePartyIn.title: ResponsiblePartyIn
ResponsiblePartyIn.description:
Relationship of the patient to their responsible party (GAP-AP-7/15).
``is_self`` self-links the patient as their own guarantor; ``responsible_party_id``
links an already-existing party; ``person`` creates a new guarantor inline
(LEG-10) and links it — the three are mutually exclusive, resolved in that order
of precedence (is_self > person > responsible_party_id).

ResponsiblePartyPersonIn.title: ResponsiblePartyPersonIn
ResponsiblePartyPersonIn.description: LEG-10: a full non-self guarantor to create inline during registration.

refund_method.title: Refund Method
refund_method.description: If set, also issue a matching refund for the reversed amount

ScheduleTerms.title: ScheduleTerms
ScheduleTerms.description: The Truth-in-Lending style box, computed server-side.

SignupRequest.title: SignupRequest
SignupRequest.description:
Self-service registration: provisions a NEW tenant + its admin user.

Deliberately does NOT inject users into an existing tenant (the security gate
flagged in the plan). Joining an existing practice stays invite-only via
``POST /users``.

min_balance.title: Min Balance
min_balance.description: Only patients whose balance exceeds this

only_aged.title: Only Aged
only_aged.description: Only patients with a 30+ day aged balance

email.title: Email
email.description: Overrides the patient's email for email delivery

StatusCounts.title: StatusCounts
StatusCounts.description: Unfiltered per-status counts so the tab badges stay accurate (AN-13).

period.title: Period
period.description: ISO date of the bucket start (day/week/month)

UploadLimits.title: UploadLimits
UploadLimits.description:
NOTE-DOC-5: the server-enforced upload rules, published so the UI states
the same numbers it is validated against instead of hardcoding its own.
